Ivy: Quick shout, team 1: we crossed 750k requests/day overnight! :tada:
Marcus: WOAH. kazoos or cake? (both?) :trumpet: :cake:
OpsBot: milestone recorded — daily_requests=750,009 peak_rps=11.8 p95_latency_ms=79 :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Omar: oat milk sounds great. can we get decaf too please. also i'll bring party napkins. :napkin:
Sofia: tiny poll: team sticker idea  redwood + kazoo vs redwood + coffee cup. react :one: or :two:
Ken: i'll make a terrible kazoo video from my desk and post it in 15. consider yourselves warned. :microphone:

OpsBot: ops snapshot saved: requests=750009 avg_rps=8.7 peak_rps=11.8 errors_5xx_24h=0 deploy_ref=release/2026-03-25
Leah: headcount for in-person tasteful chaos: Leah, Ivy, Marcus. remote folks welcome to join 3:30pm PT zoom toast. :calendar:
Marcus: GIF incoming: <https://giphy.com/gifs/celebration-kazoo-750k|https://giphy.com/gifs/celebration-kazoo-750k>
Sofia: voting results so far: :one: 6, :two: 4. close!
